overview.description: The Janus Henderson Small/Mid Cap Growth Alpha ETF (JSMD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Janus Small Mid Cap Growth Alpha index. The fund actively invests in small- and midcap growth companies, selected based on fundamental factors. JSMD was launched on Feb 25, 2016 and is issued by Janus Henderson.
